strategy.summary: TestForge's axe scan found / and /contact free of violations and found two new violations: color-contrast on /about and image-alt on /cart. Add axe checks (minor impact or worse) to the existing home and contact specs so those pages stay passing, and record and file each new violation as a defect without changing the app.
inScope: New axe-check test on / in tests/home.spec.js (existing test untouched)
New axe-check test on /contact in tests/contact.spec.js (existing test untouched)
outOfScope: Keyboard and screen reader testing, which axe can't do
assumptions: The real static server (node server.js, from playwright.config.js webServer) serves the pages. Nothing is faked.
The checks fail on every impact (minor to critical), since the scan reported pages clean at every impact and the work item names minor as the least.

risks.description: A new violation on / or /contact would go unnoticed
risks.mitigation: The axe checks fail on any violation of minor impact or worse and name each rule and its elements

defects.title: color-contrast on /about: small print has insufficient colour contrast
defects.description:
AC3: text must meet WCAG minimum contrast (4.5:1 for normal text). axe rule color-contrast (serious) fails on `.small-print` — `

Orders over $50 ship free within the city.

` in public/about.html (line 25, styled by the .small-print rule at line 7). Fix: darken the foreground colour so it reaches at least 4.5:1 on white (e.g. #767676 or darker).
defects.evidence: TestForge axe scan: Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.69 (foreground color: #c7c7c7, background color: #ffffff, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/color-contrast

defects.title: image-alt on /cart: cart item images have no alternative text
defects.description: AC4: images must have alternative text. axe rule image-alt (critical) fails on both cart item images, `li:nth-child(1) > img` and `li:nth-child(2) > img` — `` in public/cart.html lines 19-20 (Blue mug, Dotted notebook). Fix: add an alt attribute; alt="" if the image is decorative (the item name is already in the text), or a description of the product.
defects.evidence: TestForge axe scan: Element does not have an alt attribute; aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty; aria-labelledby attribute does not exist...; Element has no title attribute; default semantics not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation". https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/image-alt
